'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Battle of Donbas (2022–present)|Battle of Donbas]]
***[[Battle of Bakhmut]]
****[[Wagner Group]] leader [[Yevgeny Prigozhin]] announces that, due to a lack of ammunition, his fighters will leave [[Bakhmut]], [[Donetsk Oblast]], on May 10 and hand over their positions to units of the [[Russian Defense Ministry]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/ukraine-war-bakhmut-prigozhin-1.6833207 (CBC News)]
*[[Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir]]
**Five [[Indian Army|Indian soldiers]] are killed by [[People's Anti-Fascist Front]] militants during an encounter in [[Rajouri]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]]. [https://m.economictimes.com/news/india/at-least-two-army-personnel-killed-four-injured-in-terrorist-attack-in-j-ks-rajouri/articleshow/100007723.cms (The Economic Times)]

'''Business and economy'''
*The [[Senate of Bolivia]] approves legislation aimed at monetizing [[gold reserves]] for international trade amid concerns of a shortage of [[United States dollar|dollars]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/bolivian-senate-approves-gold-law-aimed-bolstering-foreign-reserves-2023-05-05/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Ishikawa earthquake]]
**A magnitude 6.3 [[list of earthquakes in Japan|earthquake]] strikes [[Ishikawa Prefecture]], [[Japan]], killing one person and injuring 22 others. [https://apnews.com/article/strong-earthquake-japan-ishikawa-b3fea7516c5eccfe6ab4db7131a626a0 (AP)]
*[[2023 Africa floods]]
**At least 176 people are killed by [[floods]] in the villages of Bushushu and Nyamukubi in [[South Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/5/5/at-least-72-bodies-recovered-in-flooded-villages-in-east-dr-congo (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**The [[World Health Organization]] announces that it no longer considers [[COVID-19]] to be a global health emergency, instead classifying it as global health threat. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/downgrades-covid-19-longer-public-health-emergency/story?id=99103891 (ABC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Azerbaijan–Iran relations]]
**The [[Government of Iran|Iranian government]] expels four [[Azerbaijanis|Azerbaijani]] [[diplomat]]s in response to recent expulsions of Iranian diplomats by the [[Politics of Azerbaijan|Azerbaijani government]]. [https://www.tasnimnews.com/fa/news/1402/02/15/2889909/4-%D8%AF%DB%8C%D9%BE%D9%84%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%AC%D9%85%D9%87%D9%88%D8%B1%DB%8C-%D8%A2%D8%B0%D8%B1%D8%A8%D8%A7%DB%8C%D8%AC%D8%A7%D9%86-%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%87-%DA%AF%D8%B0%D8%B4%D8%AA%D9%87-%D8%A7%D8%B2-%D8%A7%DB%8C%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%A7%D8%AE%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AC-%D8%B4%D8%AF%D9%86%D8%AF (Tasnim)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in Myanmar]]
**[[Myanmar]]'s [[State Administration Council|military junta]] commutes 38 [[death sentence]]s to [[life imprisonment]] as part of a wider [[amnesty]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/5/5/myanmar-military-commutes-38-death-sentences-as-part-of-amnesty (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Belgian authorities]] arrest an [[Iraqis|Iraqi]] [[Al-Qaeda in Iraq|al-Qaeda]] member and [[criminal charge|charge]] him with [[murder]], [[terrorism]], [[war crime]]s, and [[crimes against humanity]], for his role in the killings of at least 376 people and the injuring of over 2,300 others more than a decade ago in [[Iraq]].
